shopping_lists.name: shopping_lists
shopping_lists.holds: Each shopper's shopping list: one row per item, with the product's code and name.
shopping_lists.use_for: What is on one shopper's list. The shopper is the signed-in shopper: app code sets it.

columns.name: quantity
columns.about: how many of this product are on the list

prices_raw.name: prices_raw
prices_raw.holds: Raw zone: every price observation as it arrived, 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31. About one in five arrived twice, so a day can have two rows for the same product and store. The price is in the store's own currency (column currency: CAD, or EUR for store online).
prices_raw.use_for: Auditing what arrived (duplicates, currencies, receipts). Not for prices, counts or averages: duplicates are counted twice and EUR is mixed with CAD; use prices_curated.

prices_curated.name: prices_curated
prices_curated.holds: Curated table: one price per product, store and day, 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31, in CAD: duplicates removed, EUR converted at a fixed rate. Partitioned by month.
prices_curated.use_for: Prices, price changes, averages, cheapest store, and counts of days or observations.

columns.name: month
columns.about: partition column, YYYY-MM; app code derives it from a filter on observed_on
